author: philfalcowrites
title: Paid Comic Work for TRANSPHORIA Anthology
content: PAID COMIC WORK: Apply to be a Writer or Artist in the next volume of Ringo Award-winning comic anthology: TRANSPHORIA! No previous experience required (we love working with industry veterans AND fresh faces). Absolutely no costs to apply/contribute. Paid work for accepted contributors. Creators retain rights to their stories! Application Deadline: December 21, 2026! Link in @philfalcowrites bio! Contact via link in bio.

author: kavanaghgareth
title: Paid Artist Open Call for Paradise Towers 2 Backup Strips
content: Paid artist open call out! Yes, we're looking for new artists for the backup strips on Paradise Towers 2, out this February. Build high for happiness! Contact via DM or check @cutawaycomics post for details and email as indicated in comments.

author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers & More for Studio Projects
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE. We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. These positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more. These positions are paid but we’re open to collaboration / internships. If you meet the requirements listed, then please send a *PROFESSIONAL* email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with the following information: Name, general location; Position applying for; Resume/Portfolio with previous & current experience & examples; Rate per panel & for 60 panels (+/-); Rates for services/etc. (be open to negotiations if necessary); Turnaround Time for 60 panels/other work; Programs / Software used (Clip Studio Paint, etc); Preferred Payment Method (However, PayPal is what we will use); Other notable experience / specializations. *NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE* ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE IN THE PROCESS OR FINAL DELIVERABLES.

author: creativeleadscommunity
title: Graphic Novel Production Seeks Line Art Finishing Artist
content: Graphic novel production seeks 👤 Line Art Finishing Artist (Remote). Work on finishing and refining line art, completing illustrated pages, and adding shadows, lighting, and final details under the Lead Artist’s direction. Requires strong character drawing and anatomy skills, knowledge of perspective and movement, clean linework, and the ability to match an established visual style. Experience with comics, sequential art, or illustrated narratives is a plus. 🚀 Interested? 👉 https://creativeleadscommunity.com - Join community to access this and 100+ similar opportunities. Lead Id: 18171. Contact via the community site.
